mapper.select: select id, task_key, task_name, task_bean, method_name, cron_expression, enabled, sort_order from sys_scheduled_task order by sort_order asc, id asc
select id, task_key, task_name, task_bean, method_name, cron_expression, enabled, sort_order, create_time, update_time from sys_scheduled_task order by sort_order asc, id asc
select id, task_key, task_name, task_bean, method_name, cron_expression, enabled, sort_order, create_time, update_time from sys_scheduled_task where task_key = #{taskKey}
mapper.update: update sys_scheduled_task set enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = sysdate() where task_key = #{taskKey}
update sys_scheduled_task set cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, update_time = sysdate() where task_key = #{taskKey}
mapper.select: select task_key from sys_scheduled_task where task_bean = #{taskBean} limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_scheduled_task set lock_until = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), lock_owner = #{lockOwner}, update_time = now() where task_key = #{taskKey} and (lock_until is null or lock_until < now())
